reason: B is the stronger proposal because it specifies a non-trivial microstructural intervention, long-duration regime, quantitative oxidation metrics, and a clear falsification test against a nominally composition-matched baseline. Its lattice-distortion mechanism is insufficiently isolated and may impede beneficial Al replenishment as well as oxidation, but A is comparatively generic, processing-confounded, and even predicts a thicker protective scale alongside lower oxidation without resolving that inconsistency.
